name: IC — LDO, 4V — TO
description: Through-hole 4V low-dropout (LDO) voltage regulator IC cluster in the TO package family, featuring TO-92_Inline_Wide footprint support.
selection_hints: Requires a 4V LDO voltage regulator in a TO package family.
Designing for through-hole mounting with a TO-92_Inline_Wide footprint.
Using tier A parts from Alternate-KiCad-Library.
avoid_when: Surface-mount footprint or non-TO package family is required.
Voltages other than 4V are needed for the regulator.
Through-hole assembly is not compatible with the board design.
